counterfactual.change: Set gravity 9.81 -> 0.0 only; all bodies, dt, steps identical. Energy stays constant (2186.79) and no rule is violated, showing gravity integration is the energy source.

explanation: With no walls, no touching pairs, controller disabled (force 0, work 0), total energy rises monotonically: 3073.9 -> 3167.28 -> 3281.91 -> 3417.80. Per-step speed change is ~1.485 m/s while g*dt is only ~0.2475 m/s (6x too large), so gravity integration over-accelerates bodies and injects net mechanical energy each step until energy_bound is violated at step 3.
vision_note: Two blue bodies drift toward each other in empty space across steps 0 to 3 with no walls, collisions, or waypoints visible. There is no escape, penetration, or sudden jump, just smooth free-flight motion with the pair slightly closer by step 3.
